analysis: The layout features a three-column pricing table under the 'Simple pricing' header, with the third tier card currently missing. A matching rounded card representing a higher-tier or enterprise plan belongs in this outlined space to complete the design balance.

suggestions.label: Enterprise Plan Card
suggestions.prompt: A white rounded pricing card matching the neighbors with an orange top badge, black header text 'Enterprise', large price text '$99', light grey horizontal placeholder feature lines, and an orange rounded rectangle CTA button at the bottom.

suggestions.label: Custom Pro Tier
suggestions.prompt: A white rounded card matching adjacent cards, with a navy blue accent badge at the top, bold text 'Pro', large '$59' pricing text, light grey feature bar placeholders, and a matching navy blue rounded CTA button at the bottom.

suggestions.label: Contact Sales Card
suggestions.prompt: A white rounded pricing card matching the existing cards, featuring a dark blue pill badge, title 'Custom', large text 'Let's talk', grey horizontal placeholder lines, and a dark rounded button at the bottom labeled for enterprise contact.
